clauses.requirement: For a lamp with variable intensity, the application for approval shall be accompanied by a concise description of the variable intensity control, an arrangement diagram and a specification of the characteristics of the system covering the entire range of intensity.

For lamps equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s), or light source module(s) equipped with non-replaceable filament light source(s), the application shall be accompanied by a report, acceptable to the Authority responsible for type approval, demonstrating compliance of those non-replaceable filament light source(s) with paragraph 4.11 of IEC 60809, Edition 4.

At the applicant's discretion, the description may specify that the lamp can be installed on the vehicle with different inclinations of the reference axis in respect to the vehicle reference planes and to the ground, or rotated around its reference axis; any such different installation conditions shall be indicated in the communication form.

Unless otherwise specified for the relevant lamp, the application shall be accompanied by two complete lamp samples; where approval is sought for non-identical but symmetrical lamps suitable for mounting on the left and right side, the two samples may be identical and suitable for mounting only on the right or only on the left side; for a variable-intensity lamp, a sample of the variable intensity control or a generator providing the same signal(s) shall also be submitted.

For a lamp intended to be mounted inside the vehicle, the application shall be accompanied by a sample plate or sample plates (if there are different possibilities) having optical properties equivalent to those of the actual rear window(s).

Where a reversing projector is tested together with the reversing lamp according to paragraph 5.12.1.2.(b), the application shall be accompanied by drawings showing the relative position of the projector and the lamp and the associated measurement report.
The administrative provisions for approval of the lamp under UN R148 shall be fulfilled (heading for Approval provisions).
A separate approval shall be obtained for each lamp listed in paragraph 1 of UN R148.
